Satisfied via a different path (story unify-predicate-builder-type-resolution-cascades): Rails' build_bind_attribute reads `table.type(column_name)` inline. trails unified the three duplicate type-resolution cascades into _resolveTypeBy, whose final leg IS `this.table.typeForAttribute(columnName)` — so the `table` read still happens on every call, one frame down. The name-based wide gate only inspects the Rails-mapped method body, so it cannot follow the shared resolver.
